name: 19540 · Mohnton, PA
findings: ZIP 19540 (Mohnton) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19540 (Mohnton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
